verdict.rationale: Rippling documents extensive background automation—automatic provisioning/deprovisioning, custom workflows for security threats and notifications, automated device lifecycle and retrieval, and AI-triggered actions that run without manual intervention (e.g., 'AI triggers the retrieval flow' and 'act on it before the employee files a ticket'). This supports autonomous background automations across IT/identity/device domains, though the story's 'set up automations' framing (a user-configurable automation builder) is only thinly evidenced beyond 'custom workflows' mentions. Missing for 10: a dedicated automation-builder/rules-engine UI documented in detail, and independent/hands-on evidence confirming these automations run unattended as claimed.
